value.rationale: On a standard family of first-order infinitesimal local algebras, the sharp uniform Rota–Baxter nilpotency exponent changes from 2 to 3 exactly in characteristic two when n≥2, and the exceptional operators form an explicitly enumerated nonempty automorphism orbit stratum. The complete rank enumerator and orbit sizes across every n and q give natural operator-space invariants and expose a genuine characteristic boundary in the known characteristic-zero description; this is more than a low-dimensional example or unmotivated table.
